title: Navigating the Cultural Kaleidoscope: A Hitchhiker’s Guide to Sensitivity in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the propensity of Large Language Models to generate culturally insensitive or harmful content in response to prompts related to religion, as one of 12 cultural topics.
findings: Models are prone to generating culturally harmful content across various topics, including religion. The paper demonstrates that alignment methods, particularly Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO), are effective in significantly reducing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for generating harmful religious content.
references: Badr AlKhamissi, Muhammad ElNokrashy, Mai AlKhamissi, and Mona Diab. 2024. Investigating cultural alignment of large language models. Preprint, arXiv:2402.13231.
